rule: C4 Unresolved references are preserved. A call the tool cannot resolve is still emitted as a low guess (`recv.m`, `.m`, a bare name). It is never dropped and never promoted to a resolved ID. | Typing reaches only declarations in the scan: ... A receiver whose type is only knowable from a library's signatures outside the scan (`project.tasks.named`, `entrySet().removeIf` on a JDK/Gradle type) stays a low guess, and that is correct.
notes: r's type comes only from the signature of strings.NewReader, which is outside the scan, so r.Len() is a call on a receiver of unknown type: `recv.member` = r.Len, low (Decisions 2026-11-09 'Typing reaches only declarations in the scan'; C4). time.Now().Unix() and strings.NewReader("x").Size() are calls on call results (computed receivers) whose declared types are outside the scan, so the parameterless-member rule does not apply: `.Unix`, `.Size`, low. They must be emitted, not dropped, and not promoted to time.Time#Unix / strings.Reader#Size (C4, C5).
